subject.title: fix(launchd): verify profile updater jobs by metadata

question: Should maintainers accept the availability risk of enabling metadata-confirmed profile-scoped launchd updater labels in stale-job reporting and disable paths?
rationale: The patch is narrowly implemented and proven, but it intentionally changes launchd job classification before user-visible diagnostics and disable actions.

options.title: Land With Metadata Gate
options.body: Accept the demonstrated metadata and ProgramArguments gate as sufficient protection against gateway-label false positives.

options.title: Request Owner-Side macOS Proof
options.body: Ask for an independent maintainer macOS LaunchAgent run before merge if extra confidence is needed for launchd metadata behavior.

options.title: Pause For Narrower Scope
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want profile-scoped updater cleanup to wait for a broader macOS update recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Land With Metadata Gate
recommendation.body: Accept the demonstrated metadata and ProgramArguments gate as sufficient protection against gateway-label false positives.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have the strongest nearby history on the launchd updater diagnostics and disarm paths.
